description: This file is a Perl test script that verifies the behavior of the Coocook::Model::Messages class, including methods for adding, clearing, and retrieving messages, as well as checking message types.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new Messages object.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Adds an error message to the messages list.

methods.name: messages
methods.description: Retrieves the current list of messages.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all messages and returns the Messages object.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a message of a specified type, either as a string or a hashref.
